comments: 4fe7aadc: Initializes the update process for the PACKAGE file in the VistA system.
0453b589: Prints an empty line for better readability in the output.
cb2c2625: Displays a message indicating the start of the PACKAGE file update.
a68e5e94: Label for the section of the script that handles package lookup and selection.
c447bbea: Uses the FIND^DIC function to search for the DGJ package in the PACKAGE file.
85ca6c64: Initializes loop variables for iterating through the PACKAGE file entries.
8b4f663f: Loop through the DGJARRY array to find the specific entry for DGJ.
c0121240: Skip entries in the DGJARRY array that do not match the DGJ package name.
5c4038da: Extracts the internal entry number (IEN) of the DGJ package from the search result.
b75abf74: Checks if the DGJ package entry was not found and exits the script if true.
32573c13: Prints an empty line before displaying the error message for better readability.
89eeea23: Displays an error message indicating that the DGJ package entry was not found.
2bd339bb: Begins the section for updating the PACKAGE file entry for DGJ.
93327bf5: Prepares the data for updating the SHORT DESCRIPTION field of the PACKAGE file.
61c0b9ae: Commits the update to the SHORT DESCRIPTION field using FILE^DIE.
e5f1e796: Prints an empty line before confirming SHORT DESCRIPTION update completion.
bef38c6f: Displays a message confirming the SHORT DESCRIPTION field has been updated.
2308c39b: Clears the FDATA and ERR arrays in preparation for the next operation.
85463f31: Attempts to clear the DESCRIPTION field of the PACKAGE file entry.
e9c12581: Prints an empty line before confirming DESCRIPTION update completion.
88843148: Displays a message confirming the DESCRIPTION field has been updated.
b47067fd: Starts the section for updating or verifying FILE entries within the PACKAGE file.
c7273822: Clears the DGJARRY array for reuse and defines a new dictionary variable.
ba09a69d: Retrieves a list of FILE entries associated with the DGJ package.
9f5d57c5: Initializes a counter for iterating through the FILE entries.
defcc4df: Loop to process each FILE entry associated with the DGJ package.
71f78dc5: Extracts the FILE entry number for further processing.
3c9b4e14: Sets up the DIE string for deleting FILE entries.
36d78a9b: Deletes the FILE entry by setting its .01 field to NULL.
219571a8: Iterates over a predefined list of namespaces/files to add to the PACKAGE file.
799505f5: Prepares the DIC string for adding a new FILE entry.
556630f3: Sets DIC properties for file entry addition, including the expected file number.
979314bc: Executes the DIC command to add or verify the FILE entry.
b03a0254: Prints an empty line before confirming FILE field update completion.
05748e1a: Displays a message confirming the FILE field has been updated.
c7e09535: Begins the section for updating FIELD entries within each FILE of the PACKAGE.
005b14b2: Sets up the DIC variable for FIELD entry updates, with strict lookup.
5d18d62a: Prepares the DIC string for adding or verifying FIELD entries.
e727eebe: Iterates over the same list of namespaces/files as before for FIELD updates.
768fef05: Executes the DIC command to add or verify the FIELD entry.
eb8eac85: Sets DIE to the current DIC path and DA to the result of the last DIC call.
ed4a34c7: For the '40.8' namespace, iterates over a list of fields to update.
8cc1ef4f: For the '43' namespace, updates specific fields.
437320ac: For the '405' namespace, updates a specific field.
f59b38be: For namespaces starting with '393', sets a specific field to 'Y'.
76b155c5: Prints an empty line before confirming FIELD update completion.
e210efa9: Displays a message confirming the FIELD field has been updated.
9a3eb9a1: Starts the section for updating cross-reference entries in the PACKAGE file.
d4e39f3e: Prepares the DIC string for adding a new cross-reference entry.
e1bee5d5: Sets DIC properties for cross-reference entry addition, including the file number.
3906df22: Attempts to add 'DGJZ' as a cross-reference entry.
e90d8439: Sets up a DIC search for the 'REGISTRATION' package.
aee5e5a4: If the 'REGISTRATION' package is not found, exits and prints an error message.
ba5f37c5: Displays an error message indicating the 'REGISTRATION' package was not found.
61b8a5dd: Advises contacting the PIMS National VISTA Support Team for assistance.
3f62f898: Prepares the DIC string for adding 'DGJ' as a cross-reference entry under 'REGISTRATION'.
67be18f3: Attempts to add 'DGJ' as a cross-reference entry.
013a224f: Cleans up all used variables before exiting the script.
f71552bd: Marks the end of the script.
